where: purge-goes-the-foe · Belisarius Cawl · Canticles of the Omnissiah
why: “At the start of your Command phase, select one of the abilities in the Canticles of the Omnissiah section” (Faction Pack v1.4 Rules Update, Wahapedia, NR): the only phase the words name. The picked abilities run on with no phase named (an aura, a keyword, Stealth). The Invocation re-roll is the aura footnote on every weapon table (item 9b7d35e0f2326573).
“While this model is within 3" of one or more other friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units, this model has the Lone Operative ability.” “another friendly … unit” says the same.
“At the start of your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.”

Faction Pack v1.4 Rules Update, Invocation of Machine Vengeance: “Each time a model in a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit makes an attack that targets your Machine Vengeance target, you can re-roll the Hit roll.” There is no range, so needs = every friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit, Cawl included. The when keeps the condition that Cawl picked that canticle. NR’s “(Aura)” is not in GW’s or Wahapedia’s text, and the footnote rightly sets no range.

NR: “1x Belisarius Cawl — Arc scourge, Cawl's Omnissian axe, Mechadendrite hive, Solar atomiser, Warlord”. The weapons are its table rows (Solar atomiser; Arc Scourge, Cawl's Omnissian axe, Mechadendrite hive). Wahapedia: “equipped with: solar atomiser; arc scourge; Cawl’s Omnissian axe; mechadendrite hive”.

where: purge-goes-the-foe · Thulia Ghuld · Icon of War
why: The FAQ in Faction Pack v1.4 says the unit is picked “When you have selected the Icon of War ability”. That happens “In your Command phase” (Rod of the War Forge), so the tag must include Your Command. The Fires of Mars lasts “until the start of your next Command phase”, so the Imperatives also work in the opponent’s turn: in their Shooting phase (Analytic Reprisals in this list: a SKITARII INFANTRY unit “can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase”), and at the end of their Movement phase (Fire Overwatch, where Conqueror’s AP +1 still applies to snap shots), as well as in either Fight phase. The fix follows the signed-off Kindred Sorcery and Clever Know-wotz tags: {ph:['command','movement','shooting','charge','fight'], turn:'either', turns:{command:'your', movement:'opp', charge:'your'}}. If the owner wants only the moment of use, as Canticles and Rod of the War Forge have it, the tag would be {ph:['command'], turn:'your'} instead.

where: purge-goes-the-foe · Thulia Ghuld · Rod of the War Forge
why: “In your Command phase, select one of the abilities in the Icon of War section.”

NR: “1x Thulia Ghuld — Jericho-class conversion resonator, Rod of the War Forge”. The four rows are the two profiles of each weapon as NR prints them (“➤ … - shockwave / titanic impact / strike / sweep”). Faction Pack p9 has the same.
“While this model is within 3" of one or more friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE units, unless it is leading a unit, this model has the Lone Operative ability.” The def says the same in fewer words.
“In your Command phase, select one friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model within 3" of this model.”
NR lists Necromechanic in the Enginseer’s options, and the 75 pts are Wahapedia’s 55 plus 20. It is a Cohort Cybernetica enhancement (“…the bearer can use this Enhancement”).

“If a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE model is destroyed within 12" of this model, until the end of the battle, this model’s Omnissian axe has an Attacks characteristic of 6.” This gives Omnissian axe A 6 (A 3 in its row), with the condition and “until the end of the battle” kept.

NR: “1x Tech-Priest Enginseer — Necromechanic, Mechanicus pistol, Omnissian axe, Servo arm”. Necromechanic is the enhancement, so the weapons are the three NR rows. Wahapedia: “Mechanicus pistol; Omnissian axe; servo-arm”.

“In your Command phase, if this model is leading a KASTELAN ROBOTS unit, you can select one protocol…” This is the one phase named. “At the start of the battle” is not a phase. The protocols’ effects are the footnotes and the When targeted line.
NR prints “Battle Protocols - Cybernetica Datasmith”.

“At the start of the battle … that unit enters Aegis Protocols … it remains in that protocol until it enters a different one … Aegis Protocol: Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of KASTELAN ROBOT models in that unit.” Only the Robots get +1 T, not the Datasmith. Their T 9 matches Wahapedia and BSData, so the bonus is not already in it. The Datasmith supports the unit, and Support units “lead that bodyguard unit” (Core Rules), so the condition is met.
NR prints “Data-severed - Cybernetica Datasmith”.

where: purge-goes-the-foe · Cybernetica Datasmith · Martial Signatum Amplificator
why: NR lists Martial Signatum Amplificator in the Datasmith’s options. It is an Eradication Cohort enhancement (Faction Pack v1.4), and the 35 pts are Wahapedia’s 20 plus 15.

where: purge-goes-the-foe · Cybernetica Datasmith · Martial Signatum Amplificator
why: NR prints “Martial Signatum Amplificator - Cybernetica Datasmith”.
NR prints “Robotic Bodyguard - Kastelan Robots”. It is a Kastelan Robots datasheet ability (Wahapedia).

“While a CYBERNETICA DATASMITH model is leading this unit, that model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.” Only the Datasmith gets it, and only while it leads, as the line says. Supporting counts as leading (Core Rules: support units “lead that bodyguard unit”).
NR prints “Repulsor Grid - Kastelan Robots”.

“When an enemy unit targets this unit with ranged attacks … when this unit makes a save roll: On an unmodified 6, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound after that enemy unit has shot.” This is Faction Pack v1.4’s Rules Update wording, and the line says the same, shorter.

“Protector Protocol: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by KASTELAN ROBOT models in that unit.” The Robots’ only ranged weapon here is the Incendine combustor (A D6, so D6+2). The Datasmith’s pistol is rightly left out. Protocols are picked “In your Command phase”.

“Conqueror Protocol: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by KASTELAN ROBOT models in that unit.” The Robots’ only melee weapon is the Twin Kastelan fist (A 4, so 6). The Datasmith’s Power fist is rightly left out.

NR Categories: “…Skitarii, Tech-Priest, Vehicle, Kastelan Robots*, Walker*, *from combined unit”. Wahapedia’s Datasmith keywords have no WALKER, KASTELAN ROBOTS or SKITARII. The Kastelan Robots keywords are “VEHICLE; WALKER; IMPERIUM; LEGIO CYBERNETICA; KASTELAN ROBOTS”. The enhancement: “Models in the bearer’s unit have the SKITARII keyword.”
NR roster: “Cybernetica Datasmith … 35” and “(4) Kastelan Robots … 300”, and the unit box reads “335 PTS”. Wahapedia: Datasmith 20 (plus 15 for the enhancement), 4 Kastelan Robots 300.

NR: Datasmith “Martial Signatum Amplificator, Mechanicus pistol, Power fist” and “4x Kastelan Robot — Twin Kastelan fist, Incendine combustor”. Its rows are “Mechanicus pistol - Cybernetica Datasmith”, “Incendine combustor (x4) - Kastelan Robots”, “Power fist - Cybernetica Datasmith” and “Twin Kastelan fist (x4) - Kastelan Robots”.

Both wordings start “At the end of your Command phase”, so Your Command is right. Following Wahapedia’s wording over NR’s is also right. The 11th-edition Core Rules (14.03) word a secured objective as “until their opponent’s level of control over that objective is greater than theirs at the end of a phase”. GW’s Thousand Sons Faction Pack (30 Sep 2026) and Wahapedia’s AdMech Cached Acquisition use the same words. The AdMech Faction Pack v1.4 (14 Oct 2026) does not print Objective Scouted. The same NR export prints World Eaters’ Objective Ravaged (same shape) in the new wording, which is in BSData 11e since its first commit, while BSData’s AdMech file still has the codex’s “start or end of any turn”.

The gear lines follow NR’s six model lines (the omnispex model’s “Close combat weapon, Galvanic rifle, Omnispex”, where the Omnispex is not a weapon). The weapons match NR’s rows “Galvanic rifle (x7)” (Alpha + omnispex + 5) and “Close combat weapon (x10)”. [IGNORES COVER] carries the Omnispex mark on every ranged row and is not added again: Wahapedia and BSData print the galvanic rifle with no keywords.

“eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back or Advanced” is your Shooting phase. “re-roll Desperate Escape tests” means the hazard rolls of a fall-back move (Core Rules 09.07.01), in your Movement phase.
NR: “3x Ironstrider Ballistarius (Twin cognis lascannon) — Ironstrider feet, Twin cognis lascannon”, with rows “Twin cognis lascannon (x3)” and “Ironstrider feet (x3)”.
NR: “3x Ironstrider Ballistarius (Twin cognis autocannon) — Ironstrider feet, Twin cognis autocannon”, with rows “Twin cognis autocannon (x3)” and “Ironstrider feet (x3)”.
NR prints “Emanatus Forcefield (Aura)” and Wahapedia “Emanatus Force Field (Aura)”.
